description: Replace one screen's layout in a screenshot set. Whole-document replace — fetch the current layout, modify it, send it back. The change shows up immediately in the Screenshot Studio for human review. Requires an authorized Sonar account or a write-scope API key.

layout.description: The FULL replacement layout — this replaces the whole document, it does not merge. Never send a layout containing '[inline image omitted…]' placeholders; refetch with include_image_data first.

screenshot_id.description: Screen id (from the set's screens array).

name: sonar_update_screenshot
title: Update Screenshot
